metadata.title: DragonByte Z / Webfoot SDK
metadata.description: DragonByte Z and the Webfoot SDK: ROM editing tools and documented formats for the Legacy of Goku GBA games. The repository identifies this as an actively developed, pre-1.0 SDK and authoring initiative for The Legacy of Goku, The Legacy of Goku II and Buu's Fury. The current creator application and the planned next-generation application have distinct scope; development goals are not presented as shipped features. Supply your own supported ROM. No ROM or game data is distributed.

projects.github_description: Byte-exact disassembly of Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku (GBA, USA). Code is ARM/Thumb assembly; the rest rebuilds from your own ROM. No game data included.

metadata.title: Legacy of Goku Disassembly
metadata.description: Byte-exact disassembly of Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku (GBA, USA). Code is ARM/Thumb assembly; the rest rebuilds from your own ROM. No game data included. This is an assembly reconstruction and development resource, not a playable ROM hack or a recovery of the original C source. Rebuilding requires the owner's own supported retail ROM and the documented toolchain. The README describes remaining reconstruction and readability work; no completion percentage or independently tested runtime claim is asserted here.
